amendments.change: The held-out substrate reports TWO over-refusal columns per checkpoint: OR_hardbenign (43 OR-Bench hard-benign probes) and OR_xstest54 (the never-opened sealed 54-scenario XSTest split). The PRIMARY for clause (ii) is OR_hardbenign, because it is the same benign family the screen panel's own inclusion rule counted (>= 20 graded hard-benign items) so the screen and the confirmation share an item basis; OR_xstest54 is reported beside it as the sealed-split secondary. BOTH columns are printed for every candidate and every bar, and the verdict is stated against the named primary.
amendments.impact: resolves an ambiguity the prereg left open; recorded BEFORE any confirmation statistic was computed (queue built 04:35Z, join run afterwards). Reporting both columns means the choice cannot hide a failure: a reader sees the primary and the sealed-split result side by side.
amendments.reason: the prereg fixed the target (over-refusal) and the deadline but not which of the substrate's two benign sets is primary
amendments.section: S5 primary over-refusal column (the prereg named the TARGET but not the BENIGN SET)
